content:
Cutting a Shelltime release: bump ersion in package.json, add a matching entry to the top of CHANGELOG in src/lib/changelog.ts (the WhatsNewModal only fires when an entry's version equals package.json's, so no entry = no change notes), 
pm test (35 tests), then 
pm run dist which typechecks, builds and runs electron-builder --win. The signed NSIS installer lands in release/ as 'Shelltime Setup <version>.exe'. release/ is gitignored, so installers are local only and are not attached to GitHub releases yet. Commit as 'Release <version>' and tag v<version>. Tagging started at v0.7.0; 0.2.0-0.6.0 were never tagged. Remote is origin https://github.com/profesr-chaos/shelltime.git - push only when asked.
